title: Digital Innovation and Product Development Capability
problemSolved: King’s does not yet have a sustained multidisciplinary team or consistent product practices for moving emerging student-experience needs from discovery and prototype into secure, supported institutional operation.
whatChanges: King’s establishes a lean multidisciplinary digital product team to deliver King’s Edge and use the first year to discover what product, technical and organisational capability the wider Student Experience Hub actually needs. The team operates a transparent demand pipeline and repeatable practices for discovery, user research, design, engineering, quality, assurance, release and continuous improvement, with any expansion in team shape or capacity driven by evidence from delivery and live use.
